# universal-assurance-orchestrator

Reusable skill for running the Universal Software Assurance QA/Due-Diligence framework in this repository without re-pasting the PDF path.

- Framework source: `docs/release-notes/QA_DUE_DILIGENCE_ORCHESTRATOR_v2_extracted.txt`
- Blocked gate runner: `scripts/blocked_release_gates_sequence.ps1`
- Gate runbook: `docs/release-notes/BLOCKED_RELEASE_GATES_RUNBOOK_5.8.0.md`
